base.description: Base currency ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Default: USD.

convert.description: Optional: convert an amount. E.g. {amount: 1000, from: 'USD', to: 'KRW'}.

symbols.description: Specific currency codes to return (e.g. ['KRW','EUR','GBP']). If omitted, returns all 166+ currencies.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time fiat foreign exchange rates. Base currency defaults to USD; returns rates for all 166 supported currencies, or a filtered subset. Sourced from open.er-api.com (free, no key, daily updates ~00:00 UTC). Supports any ISO 4217 base: EUR, GBP, JPY, KRW, CNY, AUD, etc. Use for: USD→KRW conversion when reading Korean exchange data, cross-border payment amounts, international price normalization, or any multi-currency DeFi workflow.
